merchantFeed.label: Google Merchant Center feed
merchantFeed.help: Off (as shipped): the feed address answers “not found”. On: every published product of a shown category, with its title, description, link, main photo, price, stock, brand and category, at /feeds/merchant.xml on the shop's own domain. Paste that address into Merchant Center as a scheduled fetch; no key is needed and nothing is sent from the shop. No ad spend starts from here.
